# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-21

This X4 Pro release improves the visual quality of fullscreen EPUB illustrations.

## Improved

- Fullscreen JPEG and PNG illustrations now use the same high-quality grayscale conversion as book covers.
- Atkinson error-diffusion produces smoother gradients and a more natural apparent tonal range.
- Illustrations retain their aspect ratio and fit within the screen without cropping.

## Notes

- This release is built exclusively for the Xteink X4 Pro.
